description.text:
REAL-WORLD SPOTS
Surf Pipeline, Teahupo'o, J-Bay and Waikiki with up to 6 friends. Each has its own character: heavy barrels at Pipe and Teahupo'o, long fast walls at J-Bay, soft longboard waves at Waikiki. There are also four relaxed beaches just for hanging out with friends.

REEF BREAKS
Ten reef breaks, from easy Pantai Kuda to Ombak Raksasa, a 30 metre giant you tow into behind a jet ski. Every spot has its own leaderboard.

COMPETE
Surf contests for up to 6 players. Climb the world ranking, and pick your flag to score points for your country.

BOARDS
Shortboard, twin fin, fish, longboard, gun, alaia, bodyboard, or just bodysurf. Or design your own board.

CONTROLS
Phone: hold it sideways, steer with your right thumb, tap the buttons with your left.
Computer: arrow keys to steer, Space to paddle and pump, Shift to stall.
